node.title: C36' full-shift energy has an exact zero-fiber correction
node.statement: For S=H-1 and A=S\{0}, E_x(S)=E_x(A)+(2n-1)^2 exactly. Hence the full-shift estimate E_x(H-1)<=(145/4)(n-1)^2+(2n-1)^2 implies C36' on every official order. In centered-source form it is enough to bound E_x(H-1)-n^4/p by (145/4)(n-1)^2+(2n-1)^2-n^4/p, an allowance strictly greater than 39.24n^2 because every official prime has p>n^2. This corrects the zero convention in the literature audit but does not prove the energy estimate or promote C36'.
